name: baryon-mcp
description: Read Proton Mail and save drafts through your local Proton Mail Bridge.
long_description: Baryon exposes your Proton Mail mailbox to MCP clients as eleven tools: list folders, list/search emails, read a message, read a whole conversation, list, fetch and save attachments, list your sender addresses, and save a draft or a standards-correct reply draft. It talks IMAP to the Proton Mail Bridge running on your machine over loopback only, authenticates Bridge by pinning its TLS certificate, and keeps draft saving as its only mailbox write capability — it cannot send, move, or generally delete messages or change flags. Message content is labelled as sender-controlled in every response that carries it. Local file access is confined to a managed attachment folder by default, or to folders you choose, and reading can be restricted to a folder allowlist.

bridge_username.title: Bridge IMAP username
bridge_username.description: Shown in Proton Mail Bridge under your account's mailbox configuration (usually your Proton address).

bridge_password.title: Bridge password
bridge_password.description: The password Bridge generated for IMAP clients — not your Proton account password. Stored in the OS keychain.

bridge_host.title: Bridge host
bridge_host.description: Loopback address Bridge listens on. Only loopback addresses are accepted.

bridge_imap_security.title: IMAP connection mode
bridge_imap_security.description: "starttls" for Bridge's default STARTTLS mode, or "tls" if you switched Bridge's IMAP connection mode to SSL.

bridge_tls_cert.title: Bridge TLS certificate
bridge_tls_cert.description: Bridge's certificate for a verified connection: in Bridge go to Settings → Advanced settings → Export TLS certificates, then pick the exported cert.pem here. Without it the server refuses to start unless insecure mode is enabled below.

bridge_allow_insecure.title: Allow unverified connection
bridge_allow_insecure.description: Connect without verifying Bridge's TLS certificate. Only enable if you understand that another local process could impersonate Bridge and capture the Bridge password.

attachment_root.title: Attachment folder
attachment_root.description: The only folder save_draft may attach files from and save_attachment may write into. Leave empty to use the managed folder inside baryon-mcp's own configuration directory, which the server creates for you.

sender_identities.title: Sender addresses
sender_identities.description: Comma-separated addresses that replies may be sent from, most preferred first, for example "Alice <alice@proton.me>, work@proton.me". Leave empty to use the Bridge username.

allowed_folders.title: Readable folders
allowed_folders.description: Comma-separated folder names the reading tools are limited to, for example "INBOX, Archive, All Mail". Quote a name that contains a comma. Leave empty to allow every folder.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List the folders in the mailbox that this server may read

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: List messages in a folder, newest first, with stable cursor pagination

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search messages by text, sender, recipient, subject, date range, or unread state

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Read one message's metadata, reply addresses, text bodies, and attachment list

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read a whole conversation from one of its messages, oldest first, optionally with shortened bodies

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List a message's attachments without transferring content

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Fetch one attachment (up to 25 MB decoded) into the conversation

tools.name: save_attachment
tools.description: Write one attachment to a local file and return only its path, keeping large attachments out of the conversation

tools.name: list_sender_identities
tools.description: List the addresses a draft may be sent from

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Create or replace a draft, including a threaded reply, with plain text, optional HTML, and attachments from base64 or local file paths

tools.name: save_reply_draft
tools.description: Save a reply to one message as a new draft, deriving its recipients, subject and threading headers
